title.narrative: UNICEF Lebanon has made notable strides in enhancing the quality of field offices, supporting local authorities, spearheading humanitarian responses, and ensuring readiness for emergencies. Through its three field offices, UNICEF maintains a strong presence within communities and builds trust with local authorities. By engaging actively with local communities and authorities for the implementation and monitoring of programmes UNICEF ensures that its interventions remain relevant, impactful and are agile towards any onset of an emergency.;;
